exec pinax init vault --title Review --json
exec pinax note add Alpha --body 'original #topic' --dir index --vault vault --json
cp stdout created.json
review-fact created.json note_id NOTE
exec pinax note add Unselected --body 'keep #untouched' --dir index --vault vault --json
cp stdout other.json
review-fact other.json path OTHER_PATH
cp vault/$OTHER_PATH other-before.md
vault-digest vault before.sha
exec pinax inbox review --limit 5 --vault vault --json
stdout organize_preview
exec pinax organize plan --note $NOTE --vault vault --json
stdout pinax.organize_plan.scoped.v1
vault-digest vault after.sha
cmp before.sha after.sha
exec pinax organize plan --note $NOTE --save --vault vault --json
cp stdout plan.json
review-fact plan.json plan_id PLAN
! exec pinax organize apply --plan $PLAN --vault vault --json
stdout approval_required
! exec pinax organize apply --plan $PLAN --allow-stale --yes --vault vault --json
stdout scoped_plan_override_forbidden
exec pinax organize apply --plan $PLAN --yes --vault vault --json
stdout '"evidence_complete":"true"'
cp stdout apply.json
review-fact apply.json snapshot_id SNAPSHOT
cmp vault/$OTHER_PATH other-before.md
! exec pinax organize apply --plan $PLAN --yes --vault vault --json
stdout organize_plan_not_planned
exec pinax pipeline show $PLAN --vault vault --json
stdout '"status":"applied"'
! stdout '--yes'
exec pinax version show notes/index/alpha.md --revision $SNAPSHOT --vault vault --json
stdout original

exec pinax note ref $NOTE --vault vault --json
cp stdout ref.json
review-fact ref.json resolved_revision REV
exec sh -c 'pinax agent note propose --kind note_edit --target "$NOTE" --expected-revision "$REV" --stdin --vault vault --json < edit.md'
cp stdout proposal.json
review-fact proposal.json proposal_id PROP
exec sh -c 'pinax agent note propose --kind note_edit --target "$NOTE" --expected-revision "$REV" --stdin --vault vault --json < edit.md'
vault-digest vault query-before.sha
exec pinax agent note proposal list --status approval_required --limit 1 --vault vault --json
! stdout PRIVATE_QUERY_PAYLOAD
cp stdout page.json
review-fact page.json next_cursor CURSOR
review-action page.json next NEXT
mkdir elsewhere
cd elsewhere
exec sh -c 'eval "$NEXT --json"'
stdout '"remaining":"0"'
cd ..
exec pinax agent note proposal show $PROP --vault vault --json
! stdout PRIVATE_QUERY_PAYLOAD
vault-digest vault query-after.sha
cmp query-before.sha query-after.sha
exec pinax agent note proposal reject $PROP --yes --vault vault --json
! exec pinax agent note proposal list --status approval_required --limit 1 --cursor $CURSOR --vault vault --json
stdout proposal_cursor_stale
! exec pinax organize plan --note $NOTE --api-url https://unreachable.invalid --json
stdout remote_command_unsupported

-- edit.md --
PRIVATE_QUERY_PAYLOAD
